job.organization: Santa Clarita Community College District (CA) / College of the Canyons (CA)

items.item_text: 01. Do you possess an education equivalent to an Associate’s degree (60 semester units) or higher from an accredited institution? If yes, list your degree(s) and please provide a legible copy of your college/university transcript(s) in your online application packet. Copies of diplomas are not acceptable in lieu of college transcripts. If no, and you are using additional years of work experience in lieu of the semester units of education, please clearly indicate how you meet the minimum educational requirement through this additional work experience.

02. Please describe your experience working in a general office with increasing responsibility, including a minimum of one year with payroll processing. Please include employer name(s), position title(s), dates of employment, full-time or part-time status (number of hours worked per week), your roles and responsibilities. Please provide your total years of full-time equivalent experience in this field.
03. Please describe your experience using a computerized payroll system.
04. Please describe your experience working with an administrative software program (such as Banner, Colleague, Datatel, HCM, or PeopleSoft) or a proprietary system.
05. Please describe your customer service experience, highlighting any experience you have in a high stress, team-oriented environment.
06. Please describe your methods for organizing multiple projects and daily work.
07. Please describe your ability to work successfully in a multicultural, diverse environment.
08. Why do you want to work in this full-time staff position at College of the Canyons?
